Bethel Christian School is a coeducational school, offering education Kindergarten through to Year Twelve. The school is committed to providing comprehensive academic, physical and spiritual education. Established in 1979, the school continues to strive for excellence in providing a Christian community dedicated to serving the Mt Druitt area and beyond. The school is proud of its multicultural student population as they celebrate the diversity amongst its community members. The school was established to provide students with a Christian education, designed to serve them for the whole of life. Bethel Christian School fosters a family atmosphere and strives to promote a Christcentred culture within the community through having committed Christian teachers and staff modeling Christ to the students, parents and beyond. All subjects are taught from a Biblical Christian perspective and include weekly Chapel services and daily devotions. The school is registered with the Board of Studies NSW and is a member of the Association of Independent Schools NSW. It is registered and accredited to provide NSW Higher School Certificate courses to students and to provide private overseas courses through CRICOS.

Purposes and Activities The Religious Charitable entity engaged in activities in Australia for the public charitable purposes of advancing the religion of Adidam Ruchiradam by, without limitation:(a)making the religion of Adidam Ruchiradam known and available to as many persons as possible, and serving and furthering their understanding and practice of that religion;(b)preserving, developing and endowing the religion of Adidam Ruchiradam and all of its sacred expressions, including its teachings, its meditation retreat sanctuaries, and its renunciate orders of practice; and(c)otherwise serving the advancement of the religion of Adidam Ruchiradam in accordance with the teachings and codes of that religion.The Religious activities of Adidam Ruchiradam include; distribution of religious literature, preparation, printing and distribution of religious newsletter, religious events, religious educational events, missionary events, religious retreats, and responding to public enquiries.
